data.exact_reserve_text: The movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding, net of reinsurance recoveries is a favourable development of GBP 15.0m (2018: favourable development of GBP 3.5m); this is mainly comprised of releases of GBP 13.6m in respect of direct Third Party Liability business and releases of GBP 1.6m in respect of total Reinsurance business.

prior_year_events.event_name: Resolution of dispute over historic binding authority agreements
prior_year_events.impact_description: The 2018 Syndicate result had also benefited from the resolution of a dispute between Newline Corporate Name Limited and a third party administrator, in respect of a number of historic binding authority agreements with the Syndicate. This had resulted in the return of certain claims paid under these binding authority agreements and legal costs totalling GBP 11.75m.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced a gross strengthening of GBP 24.819m in its prior year reserves for 2017 and older underwriting years, as calculated from the claims development triangle. This contrasts with the reported net favourable development of GBP 15.0m in the narrative. The narrative attributes the net favourable development to releases in direct Third Party Liability and Reinsurance business. Additionally, the 2018 result benefited from a GBP 11.75m release due to the resolution of a dispute concerning historic binding authority agreements.
raw_causal_phrases: comprised of releases of GBP 13.6m in respect of direct Third Party Liability business
releases of GBP 1.6m in respect of total Reinsurance business

resolution of a dispute between Newline Corporate Name Limited and a third party administrator, in respect of a number of historic binding authority agreements with the Syndicate. This had resulted in the return of certain claims paid under these binding authority agreements and legal costs totalling GBP 11.75m.
data.data_quality_notes: The prior year development figure is calculated from the gross claims development triangle (page 18) as the narrative (page 9) only provides a net figure. The net figure stated in the narrative is a GBP 15.0m release, while the gross figure calculated from the triangle is a GBP 24.819m strengthening.
